summary: Nona is a self-hosted remote configuration and feature flag service that functions as an alternative to Firebase Remote Config. It exposes a single REST API and provides official JavaScript and .NET clients to manage application settings across multiple environments.
goodFor: Teams looking for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to proprietary feature flag platforms with specific support for JavaScript and .NET stacks.
watchOut: With a relatively small community and modest repository activity, you may encounter edge cases or lack third-party integrations compared to more established alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to ensure persistent storage is attached for configuration data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
